rows.grounds: compound kaula + sadbhāva, accusative singular masculine
compound kāma + kalā + ātmaka, accusative singular neuter

items.question: What nectar-like kaula true nature consists of desire-art?
items.inference: The verse identifies nectar with kaula true nature made of desire-art.
uncertainties: exact syntactic relation of amṛtaṃ to kaulasadbhāvaṃ uncertain
items.plain_english: Hear the nectar, the kaula true nature consisting of desire-art.
